tool_args.rationale: The history gap and transient lag favor a coupled memory ODE. The pilot already covers the target horizon, so the useful next measurement is finer transient data to distinguish the strength of memory feedback from how quickly it decays.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The similar step histories and narrow range of forecast horizons make it difficult to separate memory coupling from the memory time constant using the five endpoint measurements.
It costs less, but the endpoint-matched history gap already favors a memory mechanism. The finer trajectory batch is more directly suited to separating the coupled transient parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Single-mode Maxwell decay or Kelvin–Voigt creep
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model can explain the observed dependence on history when endpoints are matched.
